arguments.title: Jarvis.ceo Desktop Task Architecture and Open-Source Integration

facts.claim: Jarvis AI Assistant is a voice dictation app that provides a seamless experience for users.
Jarvis is open-source, local-capable, and free forever.
Jarvis supports both local and cloud-based AI models for efficient performance.

sections.heading: Agent Manager and LLM Provider Integration

facts.claim: The AgentManager class initializes and manages the UnifiedAgent with different LLM providers such as Ollama and Gemini.
The UnifiedAgent class processes user queries using a combination of function calling and text generation.
The AgentManager supports Ollama as the primary provider, with Gemini and OpenAI as additional options.
The UnifiedAgent class uses a system prompt to guide its behavior and supports both function calling and text generation.
The processQuery method in UnifiedAgent uses function calling to determine if a tool should be used.
The UnifiedAgent supports multiple tools and can be extended with additional functionalities.
The NativeReActAgent implements a thought-action-observation loop for efficient task execution.
The ReAct agent supports both computed results and procedural instructions for task execution.
The NativeReActAgent uses a system prompt to guide its behavior and supports multiple tools for task execution.
